description:
You are a merchandising manager at an online store. Your goal is to fix 'zero result' searches by redirecting specific search terms to relevant category pages. 

Navigate to Marketing > SEO & Search > Search Terms and create the following 3 search term redirects:

1. Query: 'cheap laptops' -> Redirect URL: '/electronics.html'
2. Query: 'gym equipment' -> Redirect URL: '/sports.html'
3. Query: 'mens outfit' -> Redirect URL: '/clothing.html'

Ensure all terms are set to 'All Store Views' (or Default Store View) and save them. If you are not logged in, use admin / Admin1234!.
